objective: Independently verify every face of the deterministic-selection candidate against every unchanged original sampled point, after its fixed feasibility trial succeeds.
method: Reuse the immutable independent cyclotomic integer arithmetic and outward rational Taylor bounds from check_sphere_trace_cyclotomic_v1.py and check_native_sphere_support_v1.py. Recheck every candidate face-point pair; do not infer new supporting faces from matching counts or reuse old support for changed rows.
controls: Check exact nondegeneracy and a strictly outside anchor-plus-normal point for every face. Zero-containing intervals require exact polynomial zero. Check all original vertices, connected closed oriented topology, and complete triangulation counts on exact three- or four-vertex supporting planes. Require all three native query transcripts to agree.
